implementation: Cloud directly: coupled lifecycle and simulation repair; no local delegation.
causes: Development selection was reported as full qualification, parameters were published before holdout evaluation, and no inactive-holdout gate existed.
Venue-wide queued commands were drained after the first instrument opening book, before a different target instrument book loaded. The first JPM order was rejected with no market with no fills.
The one-rejection execution safety threshold then suspended further entries.
fixes: Target-instrument next-observed-book arrival, then auction flush before the next OHLC stage.
Equity execution version locked into new validation contracts.
Whole-share quantities floor so rounding cannot breach the risk-sized limit.
No-trade or nonpositive/nonfinite normal/stressed holdout rejection; publish parameters only after passing.
Explicit development-only status; rejected results blocked in API, CLI, UI selectors and progress. Historical metrics retained.

synthetic_before_after.before: 2 cases failed for later-in-stream JPM (full/streamed); reversing symbols filled.
synthetic_before_after.after: Both symbol orders pass, full and streamed; fill is the target next OPEN.

limits: No new market-data optimization or replacement holdout score was produced.
The original holdout remains consumed. Forensic diagnosis is not fresh validation or authorization for tuning against it.
Historical results affected by the ordering defect cannot certify corrected execution.
Browser checks use isolated fixtures; real saved-run API serialization and selection guards were verified through Python route handlers.
